profile.summary: Academy of Art University is a private art and design university in San Francisco, California. Its School of Art Education trains artists to become teachers and offers art teaching credential programs, including an internship credential, and a Master of Arts in Teaching in Art Education, with student teaching in Northern California public K-12 schools.
